findings.message: Harness could not count successful tests because it passed unexpanded glob arguments to Node and used checkmark-only parsing.
findings.action: Pass explicit test files to node --test and parse the structured pass/fail summary instead of visual checkmarks.

findings.message: Static harness used a specification path that did not include the feature directory.
findings.action: Point the static check to specs/001-smart-todo-task-api/spec.md.
